evidence_sources: Public Hugging Face API (/api/models/<id>, /api/models?author=<author>&limit=50), raw README.md, occasional public HF name search; fetched 2026-09-26.
note: Labeling was blind to the cleaning rules, rule flags, strata, and author labels; only codebook.md and the model_id list were read. Input list had 300 rows (not 250). Empty repos (only .gitattributes / empty README) were labeled 9 unless the repo name or account pattern itself identified an artifact type (UUID/timestamp bulk accounts, 'test', tutorial default names, course task names), in which case 1.
